verdict.rationale: Capacities explicitly supports block-based linking/transclusion: users can reference individual blocks in other pages, and embedded blocks are identical copies where edits propagate everywhere the block is used, i.e., they stay in sync. This is documented as a core reference feature alongside backlinks and graph view for surfacing these connections. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of sync behavior across notes and edge cases (e.g., section-level vs single-block transclusion, conflict handling).
